request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:KNIGHT

layers.text: Change only one thing: erase the pink beam of light that hangs under the ship. In its place the underside ends in one short wide round dark gunmetal beam port with a glowing hot magenta lens, no taller than 8 pixels, and everything below it is empty, so the ship hovers. Do not redraw anything else: keep the two stacked chrome decks, the rings of magenta lights, the dark command dome, the fins, the antenna, the size, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
